variants.D-C0: direct aligned System owner plus full copy, no Memory allocation/lease
variants.D-Z0: ordinary consumer strong A1, direct immutable borrowing of stable preloaded vector
variants.D-C1: Memory SYSTEM owner plus identical full copy and writer/read leases
variants.D-C2: Memory ARENA owner plus identical full copy and writer/read leases, one chunk and one allocation

included: complete method query and all text checksum
snapshot released before final result consumption
Memory close and final zero checks where applicable
notes: copy phase includes Memory lease APIs where applicable
query phase includes early snapshot release before complete result consumption
SDK release phase includes result destruction or Job join and final SDK callback
Memory close phase includes final accounting, collect, drain, snapshot and destroy
source phase includes vector deallocation, never a process RSS claim
formal build has no diagnostic phase clocks but retains functional validation and accounting costs

resources.logical_requested_bytes: input payload, not additive to backing
resources.unique_owned_backing_peak_bytes: additional strategy backing only, zero for D-Z0
resources.external_source_capacity_bytes: actual preloaded vector capacity in every group
resources.borrowed_view_peak_bytes: same source or input storage viewed by SDK, never another owned backing
resources.source_plus_input_unique_capacity_bytes: external source capacity plus unique additional input backing, parser and metadata excluded
resources.retained_before_collect_bytes: observed after final lease; one full chunk in D-C2, zero in other groups
resources.arena_used_bytes: historical used payload for the one-allocation arena before cleanup, zero for other groups
resources.input_backing_padding_bytes: zero for this single exact-size 64-byte-aligned allocation only
resources.provider_published_count: Memory successfully published provider backings, not direct System calls or failed attempts
resources.unknown_reason: No allocator metadata, process residency, energy or all provider attempts instrumentation was added; null is not zero
resources.parser_peak_owned_bytes: separate SDK account high-water mark, not total RSS

functional_cases: invalid immutable lease rejection before retain
existing Job cancellation and joined cross-thread final release
sampling_admission: Only case=normal from the formal target; a later frozen device profile and independent protocol are required
